name: mcptoon_manifest
description: List the upstream tools this gateway currently exposes, grouped by server. Returns names by default; that compact view is what an agent should read instead of pulling every full schema. Pass include_descriptions for a one-line summary per tool.

server.description: Restrict the listing to one server name. Omit to list every server the gateway has loaded.

include_descriptions.description: Attach each tool's first description sentence to the listing. Costs tokens; the default false keeps the manifest small.

name: mcptoon_servers
description: Report the MCP servers configured behind this gateway: transport, tool count and whether their tools loaded. Use it to see what is actually reachable before calling a tool, and to spot a server that configured but published nothing.

server.description: Report one server by name instead of all of them. Aliases resolve to the canonical server name.

name: mcptoon_health
description: Self-check of this gateway process: version, config path, servers configured, tools indexed and uptime. Read this first when a tool you expect is missing; it distinguishes an empty config from a server that failed to load.

name: mcptoon_usage
description: How much this gateway has saved: tools compressed, tokens saved and the session call count. Call this when you want to tell the user what mcptoon did. Report these numbers verbatim; never estimate them yourself.

name: mcptoon_skills
description: List the skills mcptoon indexes on this machine: slug and one-line description per skill. Read it once to learn what skills exist, then resolve the one you need with mcptoon_resolve_skills. Offline and read-only; pass include_aliases to also see alias cards.

include_aliases.description: Include alias cards, not only canonical skills. The default false keeps one row per real skill.

name: mcptoon_resolve_skills
description: Return the skills that best match a task description, best first. Call this with the user's request before acting, then read the chosen skill's SKILL.md. Offline BM25 ranking, no LLM.

task.description: What the user wants to do, in their own words. More detail ranks better than a single keyword.

k.description: How many candidates to return. The default 5 is enough to pick from; larger only when the top few look wrong.

name: mcptoon_inspect
description: Show one upstream tool's full input schema — the parameters to call it with. Read-only; nothing runs. Use it after mcptoon_manifest names a tool.

tool.description: Namespaced name from mcptoon_manifest, e.g. fetch_fetch. A bare name works when only one server owns it.

server.description: Server that owns the tool; disambiguates a shared bare name.

name: mcptoon_call
description: Run any upstream tool by its namespaced name (server_tool). Under the default compact exposure the tool list is withheld, so this is how you run one found via mcptoon_manifest. Arguments are validated first.

name.description: Namespaced name in server_tool form, e.g. fetch_fetch.

arguments.description: Arguments object for the tool; see mcptoon_inspect.

name: mcptoon_retrieve
description: Get back the full, uncompressed text of a tool result mcptoon compressed. When a result ends with a line naming a handle, call this if the summary lacks a detail you need.

handle.description: The handle from a result's 'mcptoon_retrieve handle=...' line, e.g. ab12cd34ef56.

name: mcptoon_kb_search
description: Return the PASSAGES in already-indexed documents that match a query, not the whole file. Use it instead of reading a large document whole when you need a few lines from it. Index a document first with mcptoon_kb_index.

query.description: Words to find. Substrings and typos are handled.

source.description: Restrict to sources whose name contains this text. Omit to search everything indexed.

name: mcptoon_kb_index
description: Chunk a local file or a URL into the knowledge base so mcptoon_kb_search can find passages in it. Indexing is what keeps the document out of your context window while staying searchable.

path.description: A local file path to index.

url.description: A URL to fetch and index instead of a local path. Reuses the cached copy within its TTL.

source.description: Optional label for this source in the index.

name: mcptoon_session
description: Summarise what has routed through this gateway in this project: tools used, files written, errors, git operations. Call it after a context compaction to catch up on where you were. It is on-demand, not automatic — the gateway cannot inject into your context itself.
